sections.content:
Only 8 out of 17 actions were executed (SPACE, UP, UP, RIGHT×5). The batch was cut off at 8 actions. It seems there's a limit on the number of actions per batch (8?).
Current state:
- Body: N rows 20-23, cols 44-46; W row 20, col 47? W 4 [[20,47],[23,47]] = col 47, rows 20-23. So the body is rows 20-23, cols 44-47, facing up (white on top... wait, W is col 47, rows 20-23 = right column). Hmm, N is cols 44-46, W is col 47 → white edge on the right → facing right.
- Right eye frame is intact (rows 24-27, cols 44-47), core is at rows 25-26, cols 45-46.
- Body is directly above the right eye frame, facing right.
Continuing the plan: DOWN (break the frame, face down), SPACE (extend the arm downward), DOWN (push the core to rows 29-30, cols 45-46), RIGHT (face right, cols 48-51), DOWN (rows 28-31, cols 48-51), LEFT (blocked by the core, face left), SPACE (extend the arm to the left), LEFT (core → 41-42), LEFT (core → 37-38).
That's 9 actions. Since the batch limit seems to be 8, I'll do it in 2 batches.
Batch 1: DOWN, SPACE, DOWN, RIGHT, DOWN, LEFT, SPACE, LEFT (8 actions).
After that, verify, then LEFT.

Plan: Execute the remaining 9 steps in 2 batches: first DOWN (break the frame), SPACE, DOWN (push the core down), RIGHT, DOWN, LEFT (block on the core), SPACE, LEFT (push the core to cols 41–42).
